actions.content:
# Universal Worker SLA runtime v2

Runtime generation: `20260827-universal-job-worker-sla-v2`.

Targets:
- intake cadence default: 10s
- P95 submitted->received <= 30s
- hard alert if valid job remains unclaimed > 60s
- result publisher cadence: 10s
- completed->published <= 15s target
- health cadence: 30s, stale after 60s
- dispatch execution must never block intake, results or health

Certification requires runtime evidence, not source-code presence alone.
